questions.question: If 01 March 2012 was Thursday, then was the day of the week on 01 February 2016?
questions.solution:
If an ordinary year comes immediately after a leap year, then the day on a certain date of the ordinary year will be 1 day ahead of the same date of the leap year from March to December.

Therefore,

01 March 2013 will be Friday

01 March 2014 will be Saturday

01 March 2015 will be Sunday

01 March 2016 will be Tuesday, because in year 2016, February will have 29 days.

29 February 2016 will be Monday. 

Therefore, 01 February will be Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is **Monday.**

questions.question:
Which two numbers, from amongst the given options, should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

15 - 4 + (8 × 6) ÷ 16 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is 

By using BODMAS Rule (Brackets of division, multiplication, addition, subtraction) and going with the

options,

Option 1) 6 and 16

 Given equation:15 - 4 + (8 × 6) ÷ 16 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

 By interchanging 6 and 16 in the given equation.

 Interchanged equation is : 15 - 4 +(8 × 16) ÷ 6 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

 = 15 - 4 + **128 ÷ 6** + 27 - 7 =31

 = **15** - 4 **+ 21.333 + 20** = 31

= 56.33 - 4 = 31

= 52.333 ≠ 31 

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 4 and 6

 Given equation:15 - 4 + (8 × 6) ÷ 16 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

 By interchanging 4 and 6 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is:15 - 6 + (8 × 4) ÷ 16 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

= 15 - 6 + **32 ÷ 16** + 27 - 7 = 31

= **15** - 6 **+ 2 + 20** = 31

= **37 - 6** = 31

= 31 = 31

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 3): 8 and 16

Given equation:15 - 4 + (8 × 6) ÷ 16 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

By interchanging 8 and 16 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is: 15 - 4 + **(16 × 6)** ÷ 8 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

= 15 - 4 + **96 ÷ 8** + 27 - 7 =31

= **15** - 4 **+ 12 + 7** = 31

= 15 - 4 + 12 + 7 = 31

= **34 - 4** = 31

=30 ≠ 31

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4): 4 and 3

Given equation: 15 - 4 + (8 × 6) ÷ 16 + 9 × 3 - 7 = 31

By interchanging 4 and 3 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is: 15 - 3 + **(8 × 6)** ÷ 16 + 9 × 4 - 7 = 31

= 15 - 3 + **48 ****÷ 16** + 9 × 4 - 7 = 31

= 15 - 3 + 3 + **9 × 4** - 7 = 3

= **15 **- 3 **+ 3 + 36 **- 7 = 31

= **54 - 3 - 7 **= 31

= 44 ≠ 31

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Thus, the correct answer is** 4 and 6.**

questions.question: If 20 February 2013 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 28 February 2016?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is

In any two consecutive ordinary years, date of the next year will be one day ahead of the same day of the previous year.

Therefore,

20 February 2014 = Thursday

20 February 2015 = Friday

20 February 2016 = Saturday

28 February is 8 days ahead of 20 February, the number of odd day = 8 - 7 = 1

Therefore, 28 February will be Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is Sunday.
